title: Heatmaps of tokens for qualitative inspection

cues.en: This will be a fairly short video.
cues.zh: 這支相當短。

cues.en: I'm going to show you how to interpret and create what are called text heatmaps in language processing.
cues.zh: 示範如何建立、解讀語言處理中的文字熱圖。

cues.en: The idea is very simple.
cues.zh: 概念很簡單。

cues.en: You have some number associated with the token, and then you can print out the string of the token and color the background according to that scalar value.
cues.zh: 每個詞元有個數字，印出詞元字串，再依純量值替背景上色。

cues.en: It basically looks like this.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: So here I have some text.
cues.zh: 這裡有文字。

cues.en: If you are not familiar with the Lorem ipsum text, then it's just a famous piece of fake language that
cues.zh: 如果不熟 Lorem ipsum，它是一段著名的假文字，

cues.en: has been used for centuries to test printing machines, and now people use it just as filler text for websites to like to highlight templates and so on.
cues.zh: 幾百年來用來測試印刷機，現在常當網站填充文字，展示模板等等。

cues.en: Anyway, what I did here was count the number of letters in each word, and then color the background of the word according to the normalized length of the word.
cues.zh: 這裡計算每個字的字母數，再依正規化後長度，設定背景色。

cues.en: So you can see that the shortest words are basically in white and the longest words are in deep red, and everything else is some scaled number in between.
cues.zh: 最短的基本是白色，最長是深紅，其餘按比例介於兩者。

cues.en: Needless to say, this demo has absolutely nothing whatsoever to do with language models.
cues.zh: 不用說，這個示範與語言模型完全無關。

cues.en: But the goal of this video is just to show you how to create this visualization and how to map a scalar value for each token onto the background color.
cues.zh: 只是要展示視覺化，如何把每個詞元的純量，對映成背景色。

cues.en: In the next video, you're going to create a text heatmap like this for some real text using a token predictions from a language model.
cues.zh: 下一支會用語言模型的詞元預測，為真實文本建立這種熱圖。

cues.en: Anyway, let's switch to code and have a look.
cues.zh: 總之，切到程式。

cues.en: Here I import some libraries that we will need.
cues.zh: 匯入函式庫。

cues.en: We actually do not need PyTorch in this video.
cues.zh: 這支其實不需要 PyTorch。

cues.en: And actually, you know, I want to show you the very end first, and then I will go back and explain where everything comes from.
cues.zh: 先看最後結果，再回頭解釋每部分從哪來。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So here's the final result where we see it's actually a figure, but the figure axis is hidden.
cues.zh: 這是結果，其實是一張圖，只是隱藏座標軸。

cues.en: So you just see the text with the background colors.
cues.zh: 所以只看到文字與背景色。

cues.en: So how does that plot work?
cues.zh: 怎麼畫？

cues.en: So here I'm looping over words in a text.
cues.zh: 逐一走訪文字中的單字。

cues.en: I will show you how I create that in a moment.
cues.zh: 等一下會示範如何建立。

cues.en: Here I need to know the width of each word.
cues.zh: 需要知道每個字的寬度。

cues.en: So I have a variable that I create.
cues.zh: 所以建立一個變數，

cues.en: I'll show you that in a moment.
cues.zh: 等一下展示。

cues.en: That is, the width of a single letter times the number of letters in the word.
cues.zh: 用單一字母寬度，乘單字字母數。

cues.en: And I need to know the width of the word, because that defines how big, how wide each of these background windows is.
cues.zh: 需要單字寬度，才能定義每個背景方框的寬度。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So then I have some value of activation.
cues.zh: 接著有啟用值。

cues.en: Now in the next video and also later in the course this activation value is going to it really will
cues.zh: 下一支，以及後面課程，這個值才會真正

cues.en: correspond to some calculation from the model's internals.
cues.zh: 對應模型內部計算。

cues.en: But just for now it is the length of the words.
cues.zh: 現在只是單字長度，

cues.en: So the character count.
cues.zh: 字元數。

cues.en: I have to scale this.
cues.zh: 還得縮放，

cues.en: I will show you that in a moment.
cues.zh: 等一下展示。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So then here I'm generating the text for each individual word.
cues.zh: 這裡繪製每個單字。

cues.en: So it's at this x position and y position.
cues.zh: 放在這個 x、y 位置。

cues.en: Here is the word that I am drawing.
cues.zh: 這是要畫的字。

cues.en: And here, crucially, is the face color of the background.
cues.zh: 關鍵是背景的 facecolor。

cues.en: So it comes from matplotlib colormaps reds and then the activation value.
cues.zh: 來自 matplotlib 的 Reds 色彩映射，再傳入啟用值。

cues.en: This is a scalar number between 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 純量介於 0 與 1。

cues.en: And that can be used to display any numerical feature that you want about the text.
cues.zh: 可以呈現任何想顯示的文字數值特徵。

cues.en: In this particular case, it's just going to be the number of letters, the number of characters in each word.
cues.zh: 這個例子，只是每字的字母、字元數。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: And then here I just update stuff.
cues.zh: 然後更新設定。

cues.en: And here I'm saying if there are more than 20 words per row then we reset the row.
cues.zh: 每列超過二十個字，就換列，

cues.en: So then we draw it again at the beginning okay.
cues.zh: 再從開頭畫。

cues.en: So that's the end result.
cues.zh: 這是最後結果。

cues.en: Now let me go back to the beginning of this code and show you how we get to that final result.
cues.zh: 回到程式開頭，看看如何得到。

cues.en: Uh let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So what I do in this cell here is calculate the width of one letter.
cues.zh: 這個儲存格計算單一字母寬度。

cues.en: So it's a monospace letter, so that the width of any one letter is the same as the width of every letter.
cues.zh: 採等寬字型，所以每個字母都一樣寬。

cues.en: So I just draw the letter n for I don't know no particular reason.
cues.zh: 隨意畫 n，沒特別原因。

cues.en: Maybe I should make this an x.
cues.zh: 也許改成 x。

cues.en: So just one letter is drawn in the middle of the figure.
cues.zh: 在圖中央畫一個字母。

cues.en: And then here is some code to get the bounding box.
cues.zh: 再用這段取得邊界框，

cues.en: So I can see what is the actual width of that letter.
cues.zh: 查看字母的實際寬度，

cues.en: As matplotlib drew it in this figure.
cues.zh: 也就是 Matplotlib 在圖上畫出的寬度。

cues.en: Now we need to normalize those to get normalized parameters.
cues.zh: 需要正規化成座標參數。

cues.en: And that's basically what these calculations involve.
cues.zh: 這些計算就是這個用途。

cues.en: And then the final result is just this.
cues.zh: 最後得到這個。

cues.en: So I get some number.
cues.zh: 取得某個數字，

cues.en: And this tells me that if I am using a figure size like this ten by two, then any given letter takes up exactly this much space.
cues.zh: 告訴我，圖大小設為十乘二時，每個字母剛好占這麼多空間。

cues.en: So that's how I know how big each word is.
cues.zh: 如此知道每字有多大，

cues.en: And therefore, yeah, I can fit the text into a figure as I like.
cues.zh: 就能依需要放進圖裡。

cues.en: Okay, here is the Lorem ipsum text here.
cues.zh: 好的，這是 Lorem ipsum。

cues.en: I'm just showing, uh, splitting the words or splitting the text from a continuous string into a set of words, and I'm splitting according to the spaces.
cues.zh: 把連續字串依空格切成單字。

cues.en: So it's kind of like tokenizing, although it's just word based tokenization.
cues.zh: 有點像斷詞，只是以單字為基礎。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So you can see some of these, uh, words are short.
cues.zh: 有些字短，

cues.en: Some of these words are long.
cues.zh: 有些長。

cues.en: Here I'm using list comprehension to get the length of each of those words.
cues.zh: 用串列生成式，取得各字長度。

cues.en: Now, uh, and then this is a list.
cues.zh: 這是一個串列，

cues.en: And then I just convert it into a numpy array to access some of these methods, like min and max.
cues.zh: 再轉 NumPy 陣列，好用 min、max 等方法。

cues.en: Now the thing is, to get the color values, we need to have scalar values between 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 顏色需要 0 到 1 的純量。

cues.en: It technically is possible to use any arbitrary set of numbers, but then you would need to have an additional matplotlib normalization to get them into a scale of 0 to 1.
cues.zh: 技術上能用任意數字，但得額外做 Matplotlib 正規化，轉到 0 到 1。

cues.en: In my humble opinion, it's usually easier to scale the data on your own without having to worry about some weird matplotlib normalization functions.
cues.zh: 我覺得通常自己縮放資料比較簡單，不用處理那些奇怪的正規化函數。

cues.en: Okay, so here I apply a technique called min max scaling.
cues.zh: 這裡用最小最大縮放。

cues.en: If you are not familiar with min max scaling here, you see what it does.
cues.zh: 如果不熟，看看作用。

cues.en: It takes any arbitrarily scaled set of numbers.
cues.zh: 把任意尺度的一組數字，

cues.en: In this case, these are integers that go from 2 to 13, and it just maps them such that the smallest value is zero and the largest value is one.
cues.zh: 這裡是 2 到 13 的整數，映射成最小為零、最大為一。

cues.en: This is a linear transformation, so the data are perfectly correlated before and after the min max scaling.
cues.zh: 是線性轉換，所以前後完全相關。

cues.en: All we've done is shrunk down the range of values so that the smallest value is zero, and the largest value is one.
cues.zh: 只把值域縮小，讓最小零、最大一。

cues.en: And this is the formula for min max scaling.
cues.zh: 這是公式。

cues.en: It's very simple.
cues.zh: 非常簡單。

cues.en: You take all the data minus the smallest number in the data.
cues.zh: 全部資料減最小值，

cues.en: That's the numerator.
cues.zh: 當分子。

cues.en: And then you divide by the range of the data which is the max minus the min.
cues.zh: 再除以資料範圍，也就是最大減最小。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So that gives us that.
cues.zh: 就得到這個。

cues.en: and yeah, then we're back to this heat map.
cues.zh: 接著回到熱圖。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: Uh, if you like, you can play around with this, but we are going to be using this code in the code challenge in the next video.
cues.zh: 想的話可以自己玩玩，下一支挑戰會用這段程式。

cues.en: Text heatmaps are very compelling and very cool to look at.
cues.zh: 文字熱圖很有吸引力，也很好看。

cues.en: It also really helps to connect the seemingly very abstract numbers inside the model with something
cues.zh: 能把模型內看似抽象的數字，連到

cues.en: that is very visual, very familiar, and very palpable, which is reading words on a screen.
cues.zh: 熟悉、具體的視覺，也就是螢幕上的文字。

cues.en: On the other hand, text heatmaps show just a tiny, tiny amount of data, and it's really tempting
cues.zh: 但熱圖只顯示非常少量資料，很容易

cues.en: to over interpret noise or non-representative examples.
cues.zh: 過度解讀雜訊，或沒有代表性的例子。

cues.en: I will have more to say about that later in the course, including an interesting demo that we will
cues.zh: 後面會再談，也會有有趣示範，

cues.en: do later, where we will try to make concrete interpretations of how Llms work purely based on interpreting
cues.zh: 只根據熱圖上真正隨機生成的數字，

cues.en: literally randomly generated numbers drawn on a heatmap.
cues.zh: 試著對 LLM 如何運作做具體解讀。
